g.text: Matched terminal radius and reference flow

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Native successful 64-triplet reference — 192 exact endpoint traces
Each radius is taken at the matched leaf-vessel endpoint; no junction averaging.
Retained trunk and root radii are excluded. Flow is the exported rigid design reference.
Portal reservoir pressure 8.5 mmHg is a modelling sensitivity, not patient calibration.
These model relationships do not establish physiological validity or a coupled transient.
